init_PddlTask: create a PddlTask instance by passing config with task_spec_base_path, task_spec, and pddl_domain_def fields
reset_PddlTask: reset the PddlTask with an Episode to bind the PDDL problem to the simulator instance
register_PddlTask: register the PddlTask class as RearrangePddlTask-v0 in the Habitat registry for task lookup
review_PddlTask_class: review the PddlTask class that extends RearrangeTask to set up a PDDL manager for rearrangement tasks
summarize_PddlTask_reset: summarize the PddlTask reset method which binds PDDL problem to simulator and returns observations
